derived_fields.rendered_span_target: 'rendered-span:' + (source_key or entry_id) + ':' + display_local_loc + ':' + canonical_loc (aligned rows only)

notes: One row per displayed-token appearance; pause-mark tokens carry word_class=pause_mark and are excluded from word/occurrence denominators.
The occurrence rollup (.occurrences.jsonl) preserves the unique-occurrence grain; unique_occurrences and appearances_at_occurrences are DIFFERENT denominators by design.
loose/loose_word_unique bases are recall-tier candidates only; they are never a certification basis.
The displayed fragment text is addressable via source_card_backlink into the committed entry store; displayed_fragment_hash = sha256(ar)[:12].
